_readme: MANUAL OVERRIDES. Anything the app can't detect (or detects wrong) goes here. After editing, run: python3 refresh.py (or just wait for the next auto refresh).

flags._example: "Duke": {"conf_reg": true, "conf_tourn": false}  (keys: conf_reg, conf_tourn, ncaa_entry, final4, champ, missed_dance). true = force award, false = force deny. Remove or leave out to use auto-detection.
flags._dated_example: Add "date": "2027-03-08" in an entry via flag_dates if the date matters for redraft ownership.

upset_events._example: "401856529": false   (ESPN event id -> true forces an upset bonus for the winner, false denies it)
